currentPreparation.backend: original Python OSA already loaded; current run was not restarted

sample.selection: First 100 rows, in original corpus order, from the existing deterministic 100000-train-sentence selection; zero-based indices below.
sample.indicesEncoding: Compact JSON integer array followed by LF, UTF-8

distanceParity.fixtures: 1600 exhaustive small-string pairs, 200 seeded random Unicode pairs, 5 explicit edge pairs; each tested with cutoffs 0,1,2,3,8. Separate fallback and OSA-vs-unrestricted tests.

benchmark.sampleExamplesEncoding: Each example encoded as sorted-key compact JSON, ensure_ascii=False, followed by LF, UTF-8; concatenated in original emitted order.
limitations: Single small paired sample on this machine with the existing read-only index; no full-corpus ETA or quality claim.
